See Outputs. threads Number threads. seed Random seed. n_chains Number MCMC chains run per group. least two needed compute Gelman-Rubin R-hat convergence diagnostic. no_traces_preburnin Number MCMC traces retained per chain burn-. Lower values cut memory roughly proportionally; see run_FreqEstimationModel(). moi_max Largest MOI model can assign specimen. Specimens whose true MOI exceeds censored ceiling. thinning_interval Metropolis-Hastings updates per retained trace. no_traces_preburnin * thinning_interval total sampler effort, e.g. 2500 x 4 samples far default 10000 x 1 storing quarter draws. convergence_output Output TSV path per-group MCMC convergence diagnostics.
